race.comment: SUPER NORWEST (10) just under a month between runs when she rounded them up with ease to score a solid victory over 1250m at Randwick Kensington. Looks up to this with the 3kg claim and represents great each way value. LORD REMLAP (6) blinkers come off after he raced without luck for a fast finishing sixth over 1200m in The Kosciuszko. Proven at the trip and he looks to get the right run today. ISHIKARI (15) underrated Bathurst mare who returns from a 51-day let-up. Heavily supported as fav with a narrow head win in the Panorama at Bathurst over 1300m. Can hold a position from the awkward gate and must be respected with the claim. ELSON BOY (8) tough old gelding who keeps improving as he gets deeper into the campaign. Will relish the sharp weight drop with Stanley's 2kg claim and will be in this for a long way. Tough race.
